captions.gbp:
Fast answers and fair prices: here's what patients shared in their Google reviews.

"This practice is top notch… this place is even more affordable than most of the corporate competitors… I still wish I'd come here first." (Terrence C.)

"We got an appointment on the same day… The front staff were great and the tech was great. Got the report back that day to share with her doctors. Definitely recommend." (Fergus N.)

"Appointments are fast and within a reasonable timeframe. I never have to wait long to get in and out. I was impressed there is an onsite physician… I highly recommend them." (Ivan R.)

Comparing imaging centers? Ask for the total self-pay price, whether the radiologist's reading is included, whether you need a referral to pay self-pay, and how soon the next opening is. At AMI, self-pay MRI is $295 with the radiologist reading included, no referral is needed for self-pay, and same-day appointments are often available. We accept insurance too. Seminole and St. Pete.

Book online at advancedimg.com. Individual experiences vary. General information, not medical advice.
